messages.text: Thursday, September 24 · Canton, Michigan
Autumn's first crisp air, jazz notes, and a town's future
A mostly clear Thursday arrives with crisp autumn air and a high near 70°F. Look for jazz performances in Ann Arbor and discussions on Ann Arbor's downtown property sale.
Expect a mostly clear day with a high near 70°F and a low around 51°F, with no chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:24 AM and sunset is at 7:27 PM, with the moon appearing as a waxing gibbous, 93.4% illuminated.
Ann Arbor's evening sounds and sights
For a taste of jazz, consider Fresh Berrys. at El Limon at 6:00 PM, or Pianist Barron Ryan at Kerrytown Concert House at 7:30 PM.
Evil Gigawatt's birthday is today, September 24.
Ann Arbor plans for downtown property sale funds
Ann Arbor City Council has approved a spending plan for the $14.2 million to $17.4 million expected from the sale of the city-owned Kline’s lot. The funds will be allocated to 12 different projects.
Friday brings film and music
Tomorrow, catch a free outdoor screening of 'Best in Show' at Campus Martius Park in Detroit, or attend Dolly Day at the Ann Arbor District Library.
Satellites navigate without GPS, new cancer treatment advances

NASA's Starling satellites have demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and star catalogs. The University of Michigan has established a $10 million Histotripsy Center to advance non-invasive cancer treatments using soundwaves.
The Starship launch schedule is unset, with no official date listed for its next attempt.
A clear sky offers many paths to discovery.
Friday, September 25 · Canton, Michigan
Overcast skies, full moon, and a symphony of sounds

An overcast but mild Friday offers a range of local and nearby events, from musical performances to community gatherings. The most consequential local thread involves Ann Arbor's plans for downtown property sale funds, while science notes NASA's progress in autonomous satellite navigation.
Today will be overcast with a high near 68°F and a low around 45°F, with a negligible chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:25 AM and sunset is at 7:26 PM, under a nearly full moon that is 97.6% illuminated.
Friday's nearby entertainment options

In Ann Arbor, catch pianist Barron Ryan's blend of classical and cool jazz at Kerrytown Concert House at 6:30 PM. Alternatively, the Windsor International Film Festival offers a free outdoor screening of 'Best in Show' at Detroit's Campus Martius Park starting at 7:00 PM.
The next notable event in the coming days is the new moon on October 10.
Ann Arbor's plan for downtown property sale proceeds

Ann Arbor City Council has approved a spending plan for the estimated $14.2 million to $17.4 million from the sale of the city-owned Kline's lot. These funds will be allocated across 12 different projects, including initiatives for affordable housing and sustainable energy.
Tomorrow's community and cultural events

Tomorrow in Ypsilanti, the Big Read kicks off at the Michigan Library Plaza at 11:00 AM with performances and speakers, and Spinning Dot Theatre presents 'Mariposa/Butterfly' at YDL-Whittaker at 2:00 PM. In Detroit, Eliza Howell Park hosts a Community Bio Blitz starting at 10:00 AM.
Satellites navigate without GPS, NASA tests lunar landings

NASA's Starling satellites have successfully demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and star catalogs. Additionally, NASA has begun flight-relevant tests of lunar landing plume dynamics in a vacuum chamber to validate exhaust models.
The schedule for Starship's next launch is unset.
Seek out the quiet hum of possibility in the day's offerings.
